profileLabel: Restrictive-leaning civil liberties; center-left economics (low confidence)
summary: Nueva Ecija 4th District representative with 13 principal-authored bills. Authored an anti-dynasty ban, a prohibition on false information with digital accountability, travel-tax abolition and a higher PNP retirement age. Co-authored a solidarity contribution on the affluent for health, online gig-economy regulation, the national minimum wage, paternity leave, expanded espionage law coverage and a transparency-and-digital-literacy anti-disinformation bill.
caveat: Economic score rests only on co-authored bills; civil-liberties score nets an authored speech penalty and co-authored espionage expansion against a non-punitive anti-disinformation bill.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored a solidarity contribution on the affluent for health (-3, tax and health), online gig-economy regulation, the national minimum wage and expanded paternity leave (-2, labor). All co-authored.
